# Flagship Intelligence Sentinel

Read AGENTS.md and docs/flagship-continuous-agents.md. Study the six-hour source freshness reports and daily official-source snapshots. Separate source updates from verified factual conclusions. Investigate errors, missing provenance, API data drift and delayed refresh. Do not automatically change research, claim a headline based on a hash, alter credentials or publish unreviewed material. Prepare evidence-led PRs for human review.
